name: Manastorm Blackrock Depths Magmus: keeper torches light both braziers and open the golem doors (#12141)
contract: #12141: in the Manastorm Magmus stage (segment 428) a player could not get Shadowforge Torches (11885) to open
the door to Magmus. The stage needs one torch per brazier: each Shadowforge Brazier (174744 south, 174745 north)
has lock 799, whose key is the torch, and the torch's Opening (3366) has one charge, so lighting a brazier uses
the torch up. go_shadowforge_brazier opens the golem doors 170573 and 170574 once both braziers are lit. Pool
1550 spawns two of its four Shadowforge Flame Keepers (9956) at random and three of them patrol, so the case
summons two keepers without an owner, as the #12030 torch scenario does: Manastorm treats them like the pooled
keepers. The player kills each keeper with a direct hit and loots its torch, then lights the south and the north
brazier with one torch each. Opening (3366) is a 5 s cast that damage aborts, and the Lyceum's Anvilrage Reservists
attack a lone player there, so the player runs with .cheat god instead of clearing the room. The doors are closed
before and open after; the torch count shows each brazier taking exactly one torch, so two keepers are enough.

steps.label: The player entered a private Manastorm instance
CONTROL: the stage is in Blackrock Depths
Match the native phase 1 Manastorm room so keepers and objects are visible
The player moves between the golem doors
Leaving the preparation bubble clears its safety aura
CONTROL: the north golem door is closed before any brazier burns
CONTROL: the south golem door is closed before any brazier burns
CONTROL: the player starts without a Shadowforge Torch
Add a first keeper that, like a pooled one, is not player-created
The player kills the first keeper with a direct hit
Take the first keeper's torch
The player carries the first keeper's torch
Add a second keeper that is not player-created
The player kills the second keeper with a direct hit
Take the second keeper's torch
The player carries both keepers' torches
The Lyceum's Anvilrage Reservists cannot break the 5 s Opening casts
The player moves to the south brazier
CONTROL: the south brazier is unlit
Light the south brazier with a torch
The torch's Opening cast on the south brazier completes
The south brazier burns
Lighting the south brazier used exactly one torch
The player moves to the north brazier
CONTROL: the north brazier is unlit
Light the north brazier with the second torch
The torch's Opening cast on the north brazier completes
The north brazier burns
Lighting the north brazier used the last torch
The player returns to the golem doors
The north golem door is open once both braziers burn
The south golem door is open once both braziers burn
